title: wechat-typeset Capabilities v1
description: Contract between InkFlow (consumer) and wechat-typeset (provider). InkFlow reads this file to populate the variant whitelist consumed by lint.py rule_container_whitelist. Theme / variant / component selection is a runtime user action in the wechat-typeset editor, not a pipeline decision — hence only schemaVersion, tool, containerSyntax, and variants are mandatory here. Breaking changes require schemaVersion bump + named migration.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. Always '1.0' for this file.

variants.description: Keys are container kinds (admonition/compare/quote/...); values are supported variant ids for that kind. Consumed by lint.py rule_container_whitelist (W2).

x-note-for-providers: Fields like themes/defaultVariants/components may still be produced by wechat-typeset for its own editor UI, but are ignored by InkFlow — the pipeline does not make theme or component decisions.
